name: @cubis/vfs-action
description: GitHub Actions for VFS Server: signed software releases and workflow artifacts

scripts.build: bun build ./src/publish-main.ts --target=node --format=cjs --minify --outfile=dist/index.js && bun build ./src/upload-main.ts --target=node --format=cjs --minify --outfile=dist/upload/index.js && bun build ./src/download-main.ts --target=node --format=cjs --minify --outfile=dist/download/index.js && node scripts/normalize-bundle.mjs
